title: Acquiescence in the secondary panel
description: A Winnu Acquiescence held by a follower is offered by the engine as a third option on the strategy secondary question. The client only recognised yes/no pairs, so it dropped to a plain option list. It now keeps the normal secondary panel and adds a Use Acquiescence button (with the card text) beside Follow and Skip; the engine option id is unchanged. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.
